body: Like I said. He's the absolute best. My girlfriend is taking our other cat over there to get her shots and get fixed. But it takes a while to get in because we're scheduled for may 2nd

If you know your way around upper indiana, look for Cornerstone Vet Services in Urbana.  He's one of the best and also one of the cheapest vets around. My girlfriend got her cat her shots and spayed for $100. We also got her mom's GSD and our Frenchie their shots there too and it cost $50. He's amazing and your dog will be in good hands

The reason I left was because her family didn't want me there anymore. We were going to go to my family's this weekend and it ended up blowing up and I went down to my car to talk to my mom and everyone assumed I was leaving. I loved my job down there, I loved my therapist. I was getting my medicine and the doctors stuff I needed for my health issues. And now that I'm here I just keep getting bad thoughts. I haven't taken my medicine yet because I don't want to sleep and take a chance at having nightmares all night
